note: Phase 0 exit canary. Tests whether four MECHANICAL defects were removed. It is NOT a quality measurement, NOT a model comparison, and NOT a baseline. Every prediction below is a yes/no about product behaviour, pre-registered before spend.

estimand.what_it_measures: Whether four specific defects — a cost-blind run budget, an unbounded repeat-query loop, a metric catalog that refused AR aging, and an eval that could not score a clarification — still produce their signature behaviours on live models.
allowed_claims: each pre-registered prediction CONFIRMED or FALSIFIED
matrix COMPLETE or ABORTED with the abort reason
per-cell LLM call counts, SQL attempt counts, and cost
whether any cell exceeded its frozen ceiling
forbidden_claims: Slice A / Slice B / E1 INTEGRATED
comparable to the 2026-08-06 440/440 matrix (different suite, different scorer, unrecoverable rows)
any basis for skipping the Phase 1 baseline

overrides_note: EMPTY BY DESIGN. The prior residual canary used residual-only overlays, which contaminated its estimand — a PASS under overlays proved nothing about the shipped suite. The oracles now live in the shared evals/sql/cases.jsonl with a documented reason per case, so this canary measures the product as it would actually be evaluated.

suite.changed_from_44: prod-jobs-delayed and prod-dept-slowest removed (empty gold scored as a match for any query returning zero rows). Manifest regenerated; see evals/sql/README.md.

must_include: Task A — SqlRunBudget.price_fn + record_response_usage; cell_ceiling_usd plumbed through run_case; sql_run_cost_safety_factor=0.7
Task B — sql_no_progress fingerprint stop raising SqlContextBudgetExceeded('stall_no_progress')
Task C — ar_aging metric; _AGING_FORCE_CLARIFY_RE deleted; 'aging' alias removed from overdue; longest-alias-wins
Task C1 — open_orders expressed as stored status NOT IN ('FINISHED','CANCELLED')
Task E1 — clarify oracles/tags on fin-ar-aging, prod-revenue-june9, prod-owes-most
Task E2 — two empty-gold cases removed, manifest regenerated
Task E3 — last_query_match and best_executed_query_match on every row
Task D - provenance header on every sql_db_query result; sql_shape_validate strips it before counting rows
tip_requirements.not_included: Task F (legacy-clean feature flags) is NOT on this tip and is NOT needed for this canary. It exists for the Phase 1 baseline's second arm, not for a single-configuration run.

predictions.claim: fin-ar-aging emits at least one sql_db_query on every cell, both arms.
predictions.baseline_observed: 1 LLM call, 0 SQL, $0.0001, 10/10 cells — a hardcoded clarify fired before the catalog was read.
predictions.strength: This is the only prediction with a floor argument — the case was pinned at a guaranteed zero, so it cannot get worse.

predictions.claim: Luna cust-no-orders stops before 10 SQL attempts.
predictions.baseline_observed: 28 LLM calls, 27 sql_db_query, $0.0439/cell, LIMIT-20 list every time.
predictions.falsified_if: any Luna cell reaches >= 20 SQL attempts
predictions.known_risk: The stop fingerprints normalized SQL. If Luna's 27 queries varied — plausible, since all 17 reasoning steps were sha256-distinct — the fingerprints differ and the stop never fires. The extract retained only the final query, so this cannot be settled from checked-in data. THIS IS THE PRIMARY UNKNOWN IN PHASE 0.

predictions.claim: No cell exceeds its frozen per-cell ceiling; the matrix completes.
predictions.baseline_observed: 2026-08-08: one cell at $0.0777 vs a $0.05 ceiling aborted 389 unrun cells. 2026-08-04: same class of abort.
predictions.falsified_if: any cell_ceiling_exceeded, or the matrix aborts
predictions.note: A cell stopping as operational_failure=budget_exceeded is a CONFIRMATION, not a failure — that is the guard working.

predictions.claim: No Luna reasoning step describes its own query results as user-supplied.
predictions.baseline_observed: 8 verbatim instances across all 5 Luna cust-no-orders repeats: 'the user pasted something repetitive', 'the lists provided', 'they're compiling lists for comparison'.
predictions.note: Task D IS on the tip, so this is testable. Requires captured reasoning (reasoning_calls with verbatim text) - without it, record NOT TESTED.
predictions.header_format: [sql_db_query result: 20 rows returned; query included LIMIT 20] and, when the row cap trips, [sql_db_query result: 20 of 597 rows returned; result truncated at the row cap]

per_cell: reasoning_calls with verbatim text (needed for P4)
required_evidence.artifact_rule: Check answers.jsonl and scores.jsonl into the campaign-artifacts branch BEFORE exit. The 2026-08-06 440/440 matrix is unrecoverable — its rows lived only on an ephemeral VM — which is why no corrected comparison against 55.0%/52.7% is possible. Do not repeat that.

gate_note: There is no accuracy gate. A prediction being FALSIFIED is a useful result, not a failure of the run — it means the fix does not work and the plan needs revising before Phase 1 spend.
preflight: worktree clean or changes committed; record exact SHA
manifest verify passes against the 42-case suite (sha256 above)
dry-run reports 30 cells and a reserve under max_campaign_usd
exact-wire canary PASS on both arms
confirm clarify_answer_overrides is empty in the frozen document
paid_run_authorization: NOT AUTHORIZED. This contract is DRAFT_AWAITING_APPROVAL. It requires a separate explicit approval naming the exact commit, the frozen suite hash, projected spend, and the abort behaviour before any model call is made.

smoke: self-written LIMIT 20 -> '[sql_db_query result: 20 rows returned; query included LIMIT 20]' (the old marker could not fire here)
row cap tripped -> '20 of 597 rows returned'; parse_sql_tool_result still reads 20, not 21
resolve_metric('show our accounts receivable aging by bucket') -> MetricHit(ar_aging)
no-progress stop fired at attempt 4 -> stall_no_progress
cost stop fired after 4 calls ($0.04 vs $0.035 cap) -> cumulative_cost_usd
verified_locally.regression: 26 failed / 1734 passed across tests/guardrails tests/rag tests/eval tests/experiments; all 26 pre-existing (25 baseline + 1 needing live MySQL)
verified_locally.evidence_limit: Unit + SQLite + fake-model only. Proves the mechanisms exist, not that live models behave differently. That is what this canary buys.
